answer: In PoA, evaluator trust edges are weighted by observed service and reciprocity, then propagated through an EigenTrust-style matrix with temporal decay: each reputation score loses half its weight after a fixed half-life unless renewed through sustained honest interactions. A freshly spawned sybil therefore has near-zero eigenvector centrality, cannot bootstrap influence through zephyr, gale, or summit identities, and fails to pass consensus.
